sloka: ततः पुष्पकमारोप्य सीतां त्रिजटया सह ।जग्मुर्दर्शयितुं तस्यै राक्षस्यो रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४७.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ puṣpakamāropya sītāṁ trijaṭayā saha ।jagmurdarśayituṁ tasyai rākṣasyo rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.47.14 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the Rakshasas along with Trijata went to Sita and made her ascend Pushpaka to see Rama and Lakshmana.
